text:
dave: kicking off a config-only change during the late window (00:45-01:30 PT). goal: narrow tail and lower token cost for small requests. changes: max_concurrency 45 -> 28, global timeout 70s -> 42s, batch_window 15ms -> 4ms, enable per-tenant circuit-breaker for oversized batches. canary plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 100%. notes: https://go/release/2026-03-narrow-wave
lee: noted. please add quick preflight checklist and include an abort threshold: p95 +15% OR 5xx_rate >0.3% for 90s. also ensure fallback route policy pinned: route:legacy-fast
release-manager: plan: start 0.5% at 00:50, hold 12m, bump to 5% at 01:05 if green, final ramp at 01:20. rollback cutoff 01:28 to allow ops time. fallback: route:legacy-fast pinned and model-variant stable-legacy available.
sre-oncall: monitoring set: p95_latency, 5xx_rate, tenant_5xx, kv_cache_miss_rate, gpu_mem_pressure. alerts: 5xx_rate >0.3% sustained 90s OR p95 > baseline*1.15. pager on tenant_5xx spike >1% for any tenant.
dave: quick config snippet to deploy:
```json
{
  "max_concurrency": 28,
  "timeout_s": 42,
  "batch_window_ms": 4,
  "routing_weights": {"canary-narrow": 0.5, "default": 99.5},
  "per_tenant_circuit_breaker": {"enabled": true, "batch_size_threshold": 100}
}
```
lee: lgtm. small ask: split the 0.5% canary across 5 zones to reduce sampling noise. also pre-warm KV caches for top 10 tenants.
deploybot: deploybot: queued release "narrow-wave-config-2026-03" by dave. pipeline: validate -> canary(0.5%) -> wait(12m) -> canary(5%) -> wait(15m) -> ramp(100%). running preflight smoke tests.
deploybot: preflight smoke: OK (auth, health, quick-gen)
sre-oncall: preflight ok. note: if kv_cache_miss_rate spikes >20% during 0.5% gate, warm and delay bump by up to 10m. have warm script ready: /ops/prewarm_kv.sh
dave: running prewarm for tenants now. starting 0.5% canary at 00:50:30 PT distributed across 5 zones.
lee: early metrics: p50 down, p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +22% for tenant Q (expected). monitor tenant Q closely.
sre-oncall: if tenant Q 5xx >0.8% isolate them with `tenant-exclude Q`. also enable per-tenant circuit-breaker log: `/logs/cb/tenant-Q`
deploybot: canary(0.5%) held 12m and passed gates. no abort triggers. proceeding to 5% at 01:05:05 PT.
dave: re-running warm for top tenants before 5%.
lee: at 5% we see a brief 5xx spike localized to tenant R (3.5% tenant_5xx). applying tenant-exclude R and enabling fallback route for R to route:legacy-fast.
sre-oncall: tenant-exclude R applied. also activated per-tenant circuit-breaker for R; it throttled oversized batches and reduced error rate. system 5xx back below threshold.
deploybot: tenant-exclude R applied; fallback route for R -> route:legacy-fast applied.
release-manager: decision: continue to 100% after 15m observe if no new alerts. rollback cutoff remains 01:28.
sre-oncall: operational note: if GPU mem pressure >88% and p95 increases, prefer soft-throttle first: set batch_window_ms=3 and max_concurrency=24 before global rollback. add ops playbook entry.
dave: adding soft-throttle steps to runbook: 1) batch_window_ms -> 3, 2) max_concurrency -> 24, 3) monitor 5m.
deploybot: ramp to 100% initiated at 01:19:58 PT. final health checks running.
lee: post-ramp quick-check: p95 improved ~9% vs baseline, cost-per-request down ~4%. no sustained 5xx. nice.
sre-oncall: saving perf snapshot to perf-archive/narrow-wave/2026-03. alerts cleared.
dave: closing change window at 01:25 PT and tagging config commit cfg@z9y8x7. pushing final release notes: includes tenant R incident, per-tenant CB enabled, runbook soft-throttle steps.
release-manager: thanks all. will publish post-deploy summary and notes tomorrow. marking release: success. :shipit: 
lee: thanks. I'll follow up with a ticket for tenant R to investigate batch shapes.
sre-oncall: closing thread. good run.
